stopOn: First HTTP, transport or response-contract failure; no retry; stop after two checks
contract: Trends success, source date, array pages and mappedPlayerCount > 0. Record counts and latency, not a general performance guarantee.
Snapshots success and one requested NHL id; valid ownership/date or explicit fail-closed ambiguous identity. Record which occurred.
usage: Two public data reads only; first may scan full history once through 14 bounded source queries plus mapping queries. No writes, providers, cron, refresh, cache-busting loops or UI crawl.
